item.title: Hunger Games Director Reveals Why He Made the Darkest Movie in Franchise History
item.description: “I found myself playing music that is a lot scarier,” Lawrence tells Polygon. That included the soundtrack from the modern horror classic, Midsommar. "Some of what I was listening to is actually some tracks from that movie.”

item.title: How to save in GTA 6
item.description: Unless you're keeping the game suspended while your console sleeps, you need to know how to save in Grand Theft Auto 6 . This is the sort of game where not saving can undo hours of progress, which is absolutely gutting when it happens. There are also questions about the GTA 6 autosave function and how it works, which we can also help explain.

item.title: GTA 6 Learned All the Right Lessons From Zelda: Breath of the Wild
item.description: Throwing players into an open-world game can be challenging. When your game has an enormous map, you risk giving players almost too much freedom up front. There’s a very careful art in helping players get acclimated to how exploration works in a game without totally restricting any sense of exploration. The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild famously nailed the art of an open-world introduction in 2017 with its meticulously crafted starting area, the Great Plateau. Now, nearly a decade later, Grand Theft Auto 6 has pulled off the same trick.

item.title: Matt Damon Reveals the Surprising Secret Behind 'The Odyssey's Epic Final Battle
item.description: When Odysseus ( Matt Damon ) finally returns home in Homer's Odyssey , he discovers that getting back to Ithaca was only half the battle. His palace has been overrun by suitors hoping to marry his wife, Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and claim his kingdom. Naturally, Odysseus isn't particularly thrilled about any of this. What follows is one of the epic poem's most memorable confrontations, as the Greek hero takes matters into his own hands.

item.title: GTA 6 Caused a Mass 'Migration' of Over 2 Million People
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 was released on Thursday, Nov. 19... officially. Millions of players around the world actually got to play it on Nov. 18 by moving to New Zealand. Well, not actually. Players just changed their account's region to New Zealand. It's a known trick that lets gamers access digital games before release when companies opt for a staggered launch, as with GTA 6 . Reports indicate that, in the UK and the US, 2 million Xbox players used the New Zealand trick to gain access to GTA 6 early. And that doesn't even account for the rest of the world or PlayStation players.

item.title: GTA 6 Actor Says Rockstar Made Their Non-Binary Character Unkillable
item.description: The state of Leonida has thousands of inhabitants, each one with their own story. One of them is Cygnus, not only Vice City's museum curator, but also the first non-binary character in Grand Theft Auto history. In a detailed Instagram post , actor Jesse James Rose revealed that they played Cygnus and shared their experience working with Rockstar Games on the set of GTA 6 .

item.title: Every Future Driving Game Needs to Steal This GTA 6 Feature
item.description: I've written numerous times about my love for open-world driving games. I love racing, but I also love cruising, taking in the landscape, setting out on road trips. My heart belongs to Test Drive Unlimited . I've written a tourist guide for the Forza Horizon series . One of my games of the year is the Road Trip DLC for American Truck Simulator .
